🎉 @{{username}}, thank you for this PR — and welcome to open source!

If this is your first pull request ever, I want to name something: **submitting code for someone else to review, in public, for the first time is genuinely brave.** It's easy to feel like it's not "good enough" yet. It is. You did the scary part — you hit submit.

py-simple-wrap was built to make that first step feel a little less intimidating and a little more magical.

Where to go next:

- 🤝 **Contributor Hub** — where everything starts to make sense → https://sara-czasak.github.io/py-simple-wrap/docs/contributor-hub/
- 🗺️ **Contributors Quest** — where everything becomes a little bit magical → https://sara-czasak.github.io/py-simple-wrap/quest/
- 📦 **Module Reference** → MODULES.md
- 🌱 **Support** — stuck, confused, unsure where to ask? Ask here, always → SUPPORT.md

Worst case, I ask for a few tweaks before merging — that's it. Mistakes are part of learning here, not a problem.

⭐ A star on the repo, if this felt good, helps the next first-timer find their way here too.

Really hope to see you contribute again — you've already done the hardest part. 🌈✨
